title: Introduce invocation-context telemetry hub and alert topology mapping
author: Nina Patel
description: Motivation: customers need easier correlation between token-level cost signals, prefetch/warmup events, and downstream alert routing to reduce oncall noise and speed RCA. This PR introduces an invocation-context telemetry hub that normalizes invocation metadata, emits a small set of canonical tags for cost/latency traces, and exposes a topology mapping used by alerting rules to route incidents to the appropriate SLO domain. Changes include a lightweight context serializer, a new observability index service, dashboards for context-cohort heatmaps and prefetch effectiveness, and an alert topology that de-duplicates noisy token-level alerts. The description below summarizes the work, tests, and rollout plan. Work items: 1) add invocation context schema and serializer with backwards-safe defaulting; 2) instrument runtime to attach context-id and warmup flags to spans and metrics; 3) add observability-index service that ingests context tags and produces cohort rollups used by dashboards and alert rules; 4) add three Grafana dashboards: invocation-context-cohort, prefetch-warmup-effectiveness, and alert-topology-insights; 5) provide migration script and compatibility shim so older agents continue to report without schema changes; 6) add E2E replay test and unit coverage for index service. Rollout plan: deploy index service to staging behind a feature flag for one week, enable telemetry consumers in read-only mode, validate cohort alignment with synthetic replay, then flip feature flag and enable alert topology for a subset of tenants, monitor noisiness for 72 hours and iterate. Related: Linear ENG-3221, ENG-3302. Links: internal runbook https://linear.app/redwood/ENG-3221, dashboard proto https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/ctx-cohort. This description contains the full context and checklist.

review_comments: Oliver Shaw: Nice consolidation. A couple of nits: can we avoid adding new top-level envs; prefer feature flags via configmap. Also request stronger validation on context schema versions.
Nina Patel: Thanks, addressed in commits feat(index): add schema validation and moved feature flag to helm values. PTAL.
Priya Menon: Index API looks clean. Two questions: (1) can the cohort rollups be downsampled to reduce memory footprint? and (2) how do we handle index rehydration after restarts?
Nina Patel: Answered inline: rollups use reservoir sampling with tunable window and rehydration uses a compact snapshot via S3 with incremental replay. Added tests for snapshot restore.
Ethan Ross: CI showed a flaky integration failure on first run (timeout against index ingestion). Retriggered and passed. Approving pending small docs tweak.
Ethan Ross: docs tweak resolved. Approving.
release_notes: Add invocation-context telemetry hub that normalizes and indexes invocation tags for better correlation between token cost, warmup/prefetch signals and alert routing. New dashboards and an alert topology reduce noisy token-level alerts. Rollout gated behind feature flag.
testing_notes: Added unit tests for serializer and index, integration e2e replay against synthetic traffic, and staging shadow run for 72h. Observability smoke tests included. No customer-facing API changes when flag is off.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: increased cardinality if clients send arbitrary context keys. Mitigation: serializer enforces canonical tag whitelist and truncation, index enforces TTL and reservoir sampling, and feature flag allows quick rollback.
rollout_plan: 1) Enable index service in staging behind feature flag for 7d. 2) Validate cohort rollups using synthetic replay and compare to baseline telemetry. 3) Flip read-only mode off for a 10% tenant sample. 4) Monitor alert noise and token-cost attribution for 72h. 5) Gradually expand to 100% and remove compatibility shim after 30d.
